definitions.source_numeric_runtime: Finite nonnegative original RunTime; includes explicit source zero and does not certify IDs or clock windows.
definitions.usable_unique_adjacent_pair: Exact reference model key, unique ordered adjacent explicit StopIDs, finite nonnegative original RunTime and valid original increasing HH:mm window. No boarding or actual-operation claim.
definitions.empty_model: TravelTimes has zero original rows; never converted into a zero cost.
definitions.nonempty_all_null_runtime: At least one original row and every RunTime is null; separate from an empty array.

limitations: Only the explicitly frozen endpoint population was reviewed; later raw acquisition is outside this snapshot.
Matching current adjacent stop IDs proves only the retained original model/period/window estimate; it does not establish full-day service, holiday calendars or real-time operation.
Unmatched, null-origin, outside-reference and unavailable source evidence is retained and supplies no usable station-pair cost; no Sequence/name/StationID substitution is allowed.
